verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a CLI/SDK for programmatic and terminal-based agent/scenario/run management, a REST API with OpenAPI spec and API keys, cron job scheduling for automated evaluation workflows, and explicit GitHub Actions CI/CD integration for testing agents on every change—together these clearly support headless/CI automation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the GitHub Actions or cron setup actually working in a real pipeline beyond docs.
